stage0036_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$メラン$$
「The enemy appears to have noticed our approach.」

stage0036_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$ブライト$$
「So an interception force is coming out.」

stage0036_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$オットー$$
「The operation goes as briefed.
　From here, the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ will charge
　toward the target point.」

stage0036_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$オットー$$
「Once we reach the point,
　this ship fires the Hyper Mega Particle Cannon...」

stage0036_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$オットー$$
「We'll use the chaos to rescue
　$$バナージ・リンクス$$!」

stage0036_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「So the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$
　had a weapon like that.」

stage0036_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ルカ$$
「It's hard to use due to energy efficiency,
　but for precision fire, it was judged better
　suited to this than the Macross Cannon.」

stage0036_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$クラン$$
「I see.
　So moving all the way to that point
　is to snipe Palau's base dead on.」

stage0036_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$赤木$$
「I made a promise to $$オードリー$$ too!
　Let's do this!」

stage0036_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
（$$クェス$$... you're not here...）

stage0036_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$カツ$$
「Focus on what's in front of you, $$ハサウェイ$$.
　Let your mind wander and you'll die.」

stage0036_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（I'll make up for my mistake myself...!
　Wait for me, $$バナージ$$!）

stage0036_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Our agent inside Palau has already
　told $$バナージ$$ the operation's details.」

stage0036_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ブライト$$
「While we stir up a commotion,
　we link up with him once he escapes alone.」

stage0036_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$アムロ$$
「We'll cover the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$'s approach
　while we strike the defense force!」

stage0036_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$レイアム$$
「4 minutes remain until operation start.」

stage0036_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$オットー$$
「You heard it!
　If the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ can't reach the point
　in 4 minutes, the operation fails!」

stage0036_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$オットー$$
「$$ネェル・アーガマ$$, charge!
　All units, escort her!」

stage0036_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$メラン$$
「The $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ has reached the point!」

stage0036_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ブライト$$
「I'm counting on you, Captain $$オットー$$!」

stage0036_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$オットー$$
「Halt the engines!
　All power to the Hyper Mega Particle Cannon!」

stage0036_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Hyper Mega Particle Cannon, ready to fire!」

stage0036_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Notice to all units!
　Clear the line of fire, hurry!」

stage0036_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Unicorn confirmed!
　It appears the escape succeeded!」

stage0036_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$オットー$$
「All right...!
　Now we just have to recover the Unicorn!」

stage0036_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Aircraft confirmed over Palau!
　They appear to be pursuers!」

stage0036_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$宗介$$
「A Lambda Driver-equipped model...!
　$$ガウルン$$!」

stage0036_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「That's right, Kashim.
　I've been wanting to see you!」

stage0036_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「A mercenary's on the battlefield?
　That's just how it goes.」

stage0036_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$クルツ$$
「$$マリーメイア$$'s remnants
　and $$アストラギウス$$ folks too!」

stage0036_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$マオ$$
「What's going on!?
　《$$マーティアル$$》 teamed up with
　Neo Zeon!?」

stage0036_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$キリコ$$
（God of War... $$マーティアル$$...）

stage0036_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「You're later, Kashim!
　First, I've got a job to finish!」

stage0036_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Get out of the way!
　Or Palau becomes a battlefield!」

stage0036_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Over here!
　$$バナージ・リンクス$$!」

stage0036_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Lt. Colonel $$ダグザ$$... why are you here...?」

stage0036_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Operations like this are Echoes' specialty.
　And besides...」

stage0036_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「My mission is to support your escape
　and deliver you to the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$.」

stage0036_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Let's hurry, Lt. Colonel $$ダグザ$$...!
　I won't let Palau become a battlefield!」

stage0036_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「I'll say this, we feel the same.
　And so does that girl, $$オードリー$$.」

stage0036_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「We're back at the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ in 3 minutes!
　You can do it!」

stage0036_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Unicorn has linked up with Lt. Colonel $$ダグザ$$!」

stage0036_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Using the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ and main force as bait
　to pin Echoes down at Palau...
　It worked out well.」

stage0036_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$オットー$$
「This ship waits here for the Unicorn!
　Everyone, hold the line!」

stage0036_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't worry about the mercenary unit!
　Just focus on recovering the Unicorn!」

stage0036_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「I won't let you go, pure white cutie...!」

stage0036_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Let's have some fun, Kashim!
　Soon, everywhere's gonna be a battlefield!」

stage0036_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$オットー$$
「$$ネェル・アーガマ$$, fall back!
　All units, withdraw!」

stage0036_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「The Unicorn's gone, has it...」

stage0036_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「It's a shame Lt. $$マリーダ$$ couldn't sortie
　due to that accident.」

stage0036_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「No matter.
　The $$ガランシェール$$ will handle the pursuit.」

stage0036_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「So let's have young $$バナージ$$
　unleash the Unicorn's true power.」

stage0036_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$オットー$$
「But if we don't reach the point,
　it's all for nothing!
　Hurry!!」

stage0036_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$オットー$$
「We're doing this because you're the one
　who wanted the Unicorn back!」

stage0036_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$レイアム$$
「4 minutes of operation time have passed!
　Any more fighting is dangerous!」

stage0036_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$オットー$$
「Damn it!
　So the operation's a failure!」

stage0036_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Hurry, $$バナージ$$!
　Until we recover you, this stays a battlefield!」

stage0036_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「This prototype's about at its limit too.」

stage0036_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$宗介$$
「Answer me, $$ガウルン$$!
　Why are you helping Neo Zeon!?」

stage0036_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Like I said, didn't I?
　It's only natural a mercenary's on the field.」

stage0036_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「See ya, Kashim!
　Let's have plenty more fun soon!」

stage0036_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$クルツ$$
「$$マーティアル$$ teaming up with Neo Zeon, huh...」

stage0036_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$マオ$$
「They're the type who believe people
　evolve through battle.
　They're probably thrilled war's begun.」

stage0036_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$宗介$$
（I can't believe that man believes in a god...
　Then why is he acting together
　with $$マーティアル$$...）

stage0036_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（I won't hesitate anymore...
　I'll do what I have to do...）

stage0036_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（Even if it means fighting Captain $$クワトロ$$...!）

stage0036_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$シン$$
「Wait for me, $$バナージ$$!
　I'll scatter these guys and come get you!」

stage0036_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$シン$$
「I won't let the war-mongers
　use you and the Unicorn!」

stage0036_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$アムロ$$
（$$バナージ$$ and the Unicorn...
　What meaning could that hold...）

stage0036_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$アムロ$$
（Is capturing the Unicorn $$シャア$$'s will too...?）

stage0036_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I'll grow stronger, to save $$クェス$$ too...!」

stage0036_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「If I become stronger than $$シャア$$,
　$$クェス$$ is sure to come back!」

stage0036_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Watch, $$ジン$$...
　We're not fighting just to defeat the enemy...）

stage0036_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Keep the fighting from spreading, as much as we can...
　That's how we fight.）

stage0036_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Captain!
　What kind of half-baked plan is this!
　Just fire the Hyper Mega Particle Cannon!」

stage0036_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$オットー$$
「Please be quiet, Mr. $$アルベルト$$!
　We'll handle the fighting!」

stage0036_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「I-if this operation fails,
　I'll report it to HQ and make trouble for you!」

stage0036_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$オットー$$
「Sorry, but I've no time for you now!
　The Zeon in front of us is all I can handle!」

stage0036_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「We're breaking through, $$バナージ・リンクス$$...!」

stage0036_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$バナージ$$
「So you pilot a mobile suit too, Lt. Colonel $$ダグザ$$...」

stage0036_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Echoes' missions don't pick their time or place.
　We're professionals gathered to carry out
　any task.」

stage0036_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Though seeing this bunch from $c,
　I start losing confidence in my piloting.」

stage0036_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「But in this situation, I can't say that!
　Let's go, $$バナージ$$!」

stage0036_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「This is fun, Kashim!
　Never thought I'd fight you in space!」

stage0036_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$宗介$$
「I don't have time
　to play along with your games!」

stage0036_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「So cold, Kashim!
　A friend-rescue mission doesn't suit you.」

stage0036_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$宗介$$
「Shut up, $$ガウルン$$!
　Don't call me Kashim!!」

stage0036_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$赤木$$
「I made a promise to $$オードリー$$ too!
　Let's finish this and pull out already!」

stage0036_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$いぶき$$
「That's unusual.
　$$赤木$$ working hard for a girl.」

stage0036_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$青山$$
「Following Ensign $$リディ$$, looks like
　$$赤木$$'s fallen for her charm too.」

stage0036_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$いぶき$$
「I know, I know.
　Home is precious, full of memories for
　those living there, and memories matter...」

stage0036_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$青山$$
「Especially for people living in space,
　losing living space is literally life or death.」

stage0036_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$赤木$$
「So we absolutely can't afford a mistake!
　Let's do this!」
